english: I often get a burning feeling in my chest and upper stomach, especially after big meals or when I lie down at night. Sometimes a sour liquid comes up into my throat. It has been happening for about two months, and it gets worse whenever I drink coffee.
translation: Saya sering merasa panas seperti terbakar di dada dan perut bagian atas, terutama setelah makan porsi besar atau waktu berbaring pada malam hari. Kadang-kadang ada cairan asam yang naik ke tenggorokan saya. Ini sudah terjadi sekitar dua bulan, dan makin parah setiap kali saya minum kopi.
translator_notes: 'Burning feeling' = 'panas seperti terbakar' (alt. 'rasa terbakar', 'perih'); 'upper stomach' = 'perut bagian atas' (alt. 'ulu hati'). 'Big meals' = 'makan porsi besar' (alt. 'makan banyak/kekenyangan'); 'makin' and 'semakin' are both standard.

speaker: patient
english: I am here for my blood pressure follow-up. I have been taking my medicine every morning, but sometimes I forget on the weekends. When I checked at home last week, the reading was around one hundred and fifty over ninety-five. I have also been getting headaches at the back of my head.
translation: Saya datang untuk kontrol tekanan darah. Selama ini saya minum obat setiap pagi, tetapi kadang-kadang saya lupa kalau akhir pekan. Waktu saya cek di rumah minggu lalu, hasilnya sekitar seratus lima puluh per sembilan puluh lima. Saya juga mengalami sakit kepala di bagian belakang.
translator_notes: 'Follow-up' = 'kontrol', the usual Indonesian clinic term (alt. 'pemeriksaan lanjutan'). BP '150 over 95' read as 'seratus lima puluh per sembilan puluh lima' (alt. without 'per', or 'garis miring'). 'Headaches at the back of my head' = 'sakit kepala di bagian belakang' (alt. 'kepala bagian belakang terasa sakit').

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is still higher than we would like it to be. I am going to increase the dose of your medication from five milligrams to ten milligrams once a day. Please also try to cut down on salty food, such as instant noodles, soups and sauces, and exercise regularly.
translation: Tekanan darah Anda hari ini masih lebih tinggi dari yang kami harapkan. Saya akan menaikkan dosis obat Anda dari lima miligram menjadi sepuluh miligram sekali sehari. Tolong juga usahakan untuk mengurangi makanan yang asin, seperti mi instan, sup, dan saus, serta rutin berolahraga.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses patient as 'Anda'. 'mi instan' follows EYD/KBBI spelling (model may write 'mie instan'); 'menaikkan dosis' could also be 'meningkatkan dosis', and 'rutin berolahraga' could be 'berolahraga secara teratur'.

speaker: patient
english: I have been feeling very thirsty lately, and I need to go to the toilet many times at night to pass urine. I have also lost about four kilograms in the last two months even though I was not trying to diet. My mother has diabetes, so I am a bit worried.
translation: Akhir-akhir ini saya merasa sangat haus, dan pada malam hari saya harus ke toilet berkali-kali untuk buang air kecil. Berat badan saya juga turun sekitar empat kilogram dalam dua bulan terakhir, padahal saya tidak sedang berusaha diet. Ibu saya menderita diabetes, jadi saya agak khawatir.
translator_notes: 'Pass urine' rendered as the neutral lay term 'buang air kecil' (alternatives: 'kencing', 'berkemih'). 'Akhir-akhir ini' may also appear as 'belakangan ini'; 'diabetes' may also be 'kencing manis' in lay speech.

speaker: doctor
english: Your HbA1c result is eight point five percent, which means your blood sugar has been poorly controlled over the past three months. I would like to start you on metformin, one tablet twice a day after meals. You may have some stomach upset at first, but it usually gets better.
translation: Hasil HbA1c Anda delapan koma lima persen, yang berarti gula darah Anda tidak terkontrol dengan baik selama tiga bulan terakhir. Saya ingin mulai memberi Anda metformin, satu tablet dua kali sehari setelah makan. Awalnya Anda mungkin mengalami gangguan perut, tetapi biasanya akan membaik.
translator_notes: 'HbA1c' and 'metformin' kept as loanwords in Latin script; decimal spoken as 'delapan koma lima persen'. 'Stomach upset' rendered 'gangguan perut' (alternatives: 'sakit perut', 'perut tidak nyaman', 'gangguan pencernaan').

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood test shows that your bad cholesterol, LDL, is quite high, which increases your risk of heart attack and stroke. I recommend starting a statin, which you take once a day at night. We will repeat the blood test in three months to check your liver and cholesterol levels.
translation: Hasil tes darah Anda menunjukkan bahwa kolesterol jahat Anda, yaitu LDL, cukup tinggi, sehingga meningkatkan risiko serangan jantung dan stroke. Saya sarankan Anda mulai mengonsumsi statin, yang diminum sekali sehari pada malam hari. Kita akan mengulang tes darah tiga bulan lagi untuk memeriksa hati dan kadar kolesterol Anda.
translator_notes: 'LDL', 'statin' and 'stroke' kept as loanwords (a model may add 'obat statin'). 'Blood test' = 'tes darah' (alternative: 'pemeriksaan darah'); 'check your liver' kept literal as 'memeriksa hati', though 'fungsi hati' is a common clinical alternative.

speaker: patient
english: I keep getting very bad headaches on one side of my head, usually two or three times a week. When it happens, I feel like vomiting and I cannot stand bright lights or loud noises. The painkillers I bought from the pharmacy don't help much anymore.
translation: Saya berulang kali mengalami sakit kepala yang sangat hebat di satu sisi kepala, biasanya dua atau tiga kali seminggu. Kalau sedang kambuh, saya rasanya ingin muntah dan saya tidak tahan dengan cahaya terang atau suara keras. Obat pereda nyeri yang saya beli di apotek sudah tidak terlalu membantu lagi.
translator_notes: 'Painkillers' = 'obat pereda nyeri' (alternatives: 'obat antinyeri', 'obat penghilang rasa sakit'). 'When it happens' rendered naturally as 'Kalau sedang kambuh' (alternative: 'Saat sakitnya datang'); 'feel like vomiting' = 'rasanya ingin muntah' (alternative: 'mual').

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back when I was lifting a heavy box at work on Monday. The pain is very sharp when I bend forward or get up from a chair. Sometimes the pain goes down to the back of my right leg, and my toes feel a bit numb.
translation: Punggung bawah saya cedera waktu saya mengangkat kotak yang berat di tempat kerja pada hari Senin. Sakitnya terasa sangat menusuk kalau saya membungkuk ke depan atau bangun dari kursi. Kadang-kadang sakitnya menjalar ke bagian belakang kaki kanan saya, dan jari-jari kaki saya terasa agak mati rasa.
translator_notes: 'Sharp' pain rendered with the natural 'menusuk' (alternative: 'tajam'); 'numb' = 'mati rasa', the usual Indonesian term (alternatives: 'baal', 'kesemutan'; 'kebas' is Malay-leaning). 'Leg' = lay 'kaki' (clinical alternative: 'tungkai'); 'goes down' = 'menjalar'.

speaker: doctor
english: This looks like a muscle strain in your lower back. I will give you painkillers, a muscle relaxant, and a medical certificate for three days. Try to keep moving gently instead of staying in bed all day. If you have weakness in your legs or problems controlling your bladder, go to the emergency department immediately.
translation: Sepertinya ini ketegangan otot di punggung bawah Anda. Saya akan memberi Anda obat pereda nyeri, obat pelemas otot, dan surat keterangan sakit untuk tiga hari. Usahakan untuk tetap bergerak perlahan, alih-alih berbaring di tempat tidur seharian. Jika kaki Anda terasa lemah atau Anda kesulitan mengendalikan buang air kecil, segera pergi ke IGD.
translator_notes: 'Muscle strain' = 'ketegangan otot' (alternatives: 'otot tertarik', 'cedera otot'); 'muscle relaxant' = 'obat pelemas otot' (alternative: 'relaksan otot'); 'medical certificate' = 'surat keterangan sakit' (colloquially 'surat sakit'). 'Emergency department' = 'IGD' as normally said in Indonesia (alternatives: 'instalasi gawat darurat', 'unit gawat darurat/UGD').

speaker: patient
english: It hurts and burns every time I pass urine, and I feel like I need to go to the toilet all the time, but only a little comes out. Since this morning my urine also looks cloudy and has a strong smell. I have a little pain in my lower belly too.
translation: Setiap kali buang air kecil rasanya sakit dan perih, dan saya merasa ingin ke toilet terus, tetapi yang keluar hanya sedikit. Sejak tadi pagi, air kencing saya juga terlihat keruh dan baunya menyengat. Perut bagian bawah saya juga agak sakit.
translator_notes: 'Burns' = 'perih' (alternative: 'panas'); urine = lay 'air kencing' (alternatives: 'air seni', 'urine'). The idiom 'anyang-anyangan' was avoided in favour of an explicit description; 'strong smell' = 'baunya menyengat'.

speaker: patient
english: I have this itchy red rash on the inside of my elbows and behind my knees. It gets worse at night, and I keep scratching until the skin bleeds. I have tried using moisturiser, but it doesn't seem to help. Could it be an allergy to my new soap?
translation: Saya ada ruam merah yang gatal di bagian dalam siku dan di belakang lutut saya. Rasanya makin parah pada malam hari, dan saya terus menggaruknya sampai kulitnya berdarah. Saya sudah mencoba memakai pelembap, tetapi sepertinya tidak membantu. Mungkinkah ini alergi terhadap sabun baru saya?
translator_notes: 'Rash' = 'ruam'; 'moisturiser' = 'pelembap' (EYD spelling; 'pelembab' is a common misspelling). 'Saya ada ruam' is natural spoken form (alternative: 'Saya punya ruam' / 'Ada ruam'); 'Could it be' = 'Mungkinkah' (alternative: 'Apakah mungkin').

speaker: doctor
english: This is eczema, which is a common condition where the skin becomes dry and inflamed. I will give you a steroid cream to apply thinly twice a day on the red areas, for one week only. Use a gentle soap-free wash, and apply moisturiser generously several times a day, even after the rash is gone.
translation: Ini adalah eksim, yaitu kondisi umum yang membuat kulit menjadi kering dan meradang. Saya akan memberi Anda krim steroid untuk dioleskan tipis-tipis dua kali sehari pada bagian yang merah, selama satu minggu saja. Gunakan pembersih bebas sabun yang lembut, dan oleskan pelembap dalam jumlah banyak beberapa kali sehari, bahkan setelah ruamnya hilang.
translator_notes: 'Eczema' = 'eksim' (alternatives: 'eksem', 'dermatitis atopik'); 'soap-free wash' = 'pembersih bebas sabun' (alternatives: 'pembersih tanpa sabun', 'cairan pembersih non-sabun'). 'Generously' = 'dalam jumlah banyak' (alternative: 'secara banyak/tebal').

speaker: patient
english: My son is four years old and he has had a fever since yesterday. Today I noticed small blisters on his palms and the soles of his feet, and he has some ulcers in his mouth. He refuses to eat or drink because it hurts. His preschool said another child had hand, foot and mouth disease.
translation: Anak laki-laki saya berusia empat tahun dan dia demam sejak kemarin. Hari ini saya melihat ada lepuhan kecil di telapak tangan dan telapak kakinya, dan ada beberapa sariawan di mulutnya. Dia menolak makan atau minum karena terasa sakit. Pihak prasekolahnya mengatakan ada anak lain yang terkena penyakit tangan, kaki, dan mulut.
translator_notes: 'Blisters' = 'lepuhan' (alternatives: 'lenting', 'bintil berair'); mouth 'ulcers' = lay 'sariawan' (alternative: 'luka di mulut'). HFMD = 'penyakit tangan, kaki, dan mulut' (commonly also 'flu Singapura' or 'HFMD' in Indonesia); 'preschool' = 'prasekolah' (alternatives: 'TK', 'PAUD').

speaker: doctor
english: Your son has hand, foot and mouth disease. It is caused by a virus and usually gets better on its own within seven to ten days. He must stay at home and not go to preschool until all the blisters have dried. Make sure he drinks enough fluids, and bring him back if he becomes very drowsy or stops passing urine.
translation: Putra Anda terkena penyakit tangan, kaki, dan mulut. Penyakit ini disebabkan oleh virus dan biasanya sembuh sendiri dalam tujuh sampai sepuluh hari. Dia harus tinggal di rumah dan tidak boleh pergi ke prasekolah sampai semua lepuhannya mengering. Pastikan dia minum cukup cairan, dan bawa dia kembali ke sini jika dia menjadi sangat mengantuk atau berhenti buang air kecil.
translator_notes: Doctor uses polite 'Putra Anda' for 'your son' (alternative: 'Anak Anda'). HFMD = 'penyakit tangan, kaki, dan mulut' (alternatives: 'flu Singapura', 'HFMD'); 'seven to ten' may also be 'tujuh hingga sepuluh'; 'stops passing urine' = 'berhenti buang air kecil' (alternative: 'tidak buang air kecil lagi').

speaker: patient
english: Every morning when I wake up, I sneeze non-stop and my nose is very runny and itchy. My eyes also become watery and red. It seems to be worse when I clean my room or when there is haze. This has been going on for years, but lately it is getting worse.
translation: Setiap pagi saat bangun tidur, saya bersin terus-menerus dan hidung saya sangat meler serta gatal. Mata saya juga jadi berair dan merah. Sepertinya keluhan ini makin parah kalau saya membersihkan kamar atau kalau ada kabut asap. Ini sudah berlangsung bertahun-tahun, tetapi akhir-akhir ini makin parah.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'saya'. 'runny nose' = 'hidung meler' (alt. 'pilek', 'ingusan'); 'haze' = 'kabut asap' (alt. 'asap'). 'non-stop' = 'terus-menerus' (alt. 'tidak berhenti-berhenti'); 'lately' = 'akhir-akhir ini' (alt. 'belakangan ini').

speaker: patient
english: My left eye became red and swollen yesterday, and this morning when I woke up, my eyelashes were stuck together with yellow discharge. It feels gritty, like there is sand inside. Now my right eye is starting to turn red as well. I wear contact lenses for work.
translation: Mata kiri saya menjadi merah dan bengkak kemarin, dan pagi ini waktu bangun tidur, bulu mata saya saling menempel karena kotoran mata berwarna kuning. Rasanya mengganjal, seperti ada pasir di dalamnya. Sekarang mata kanan saya juga mulai memerah. Saya memakai lensa kontak untuk bekerja.
translator_notes: 'yellow discharge' = 'kotoran mata berwarna kuning' (colloquial alt. 'belek kuning'); 'gritty' = 'mengganjal' (alt. 'berpasir', 'seperti kelilipan'). 'stuck together' = 'saling menempel' (alt. 'lengket'); 'contact lenses' = 'lensa kontak' (alt. loanword 'softlens').

speaker: patient
english: Last night I woke up with a terrible pain in my big toe. It is red, hot and so swollen that I cannot even put on my shoe or let the blanket touch it. I had a lot of beer and seafood at a wedding dinner on Saturday. Is this gout?
translation: Tadi malam saya terbangun karena nyeri yang luar biasa di jempol kaki saya. Jempolnya merah, panas, dan bengkak sekali sampai saya bahkan tidak bisa memakai sepatu atau membiarkan selimut menyentuhnya. Saya banyak minum bir dan makan makanan laut di acara makan malam pernikahan pada hari Sabtu. Apakah ini asam urat?
translator_notes: 'gout' rendered with the common Indonesian lay term 'asam urat' (clinical alt. 'gout', 'artritis gout', 'pirai'). 'big toe' = 'jempol kaki' (alt. 'ibu jari kaki'); 'seafood' = 'makanan laut' (loanword 'seafood' is very common in speech). 'terrible pain' = 'nyeri yang luar biasa' (alt. 'sakit sekali', 'nyeri hebat').

speaker: patient
english: My knees have been aching for a few years, but recently the pain is much worse, especially when I go up and down the stairs or stand up after sitting for a long time. Sometimes I hear a cracking sound. In the morning my knees feel stiff for about fifteen minutes.
translation: Lutut saya sudah sakit selama beberapa tahun, tetapi belakangan ini nyerinya jauh lebih parah, terutama saat saya naik turun tangga atau berdiri setelah duduk lama. Kadang-kadang saya mendengar bunyi berderak. Pada pagi hari lutut saya terasa kaku selama sekitar lima belas menit.
translator_notes: 'aching' = 'sakit' (alt. 'nyeri', 'pegal'); 'cracking sound' = 'bunyi berderak' (colloquial alt. 'bunyi krek', 'bunyi kretek'). Number spelled 'lima belas menit'.

speaker: patient
english: For the past two months, I have not been able to sleep well. I lie in bed for hours thinking about work, and I wake up at four in the morning and cannot fall back asleep. I feel tired and irritable all day, and I have lost interest in things I used to enjoy.
translation: Selama dua bulan terakhir, saya tidak bisa tidur nyenyak. Saya berbaring di tempat tidur berjam-jam memikirkan pekerjaan, lalu saya terbangun jam empat pagi dan tidak bisa tidur lagi. Saya merasa lelah dan mudah marah sepanjang hari, dan saya sudah kehilangan minat pada hal-hal yang dulu saya sukai.
translator_notes: 'irritable' = 'mudah marah' (alt. 'mudah tersinggung', 'gampang kesal'); 'sleep well' = 'tidur nyenyak'. Time given as spoken 'jam empat pagi' (alt. formal 'pukul empat pagi'); 'cannot fall back asleep' = 'tidak bisa tidur lagi' (alt. 'tidak bisa tidur kembali').

speaker: patient
english: Whenever I turn my head quickly or roll over in bed, the whole room starts spinning for about half a minute. I feel very nauseous during these episodes. It started three days ago. I don't have any weakness in my arms or legs, and my speech is normal.
translation: Setiap kali saya menoleh dengan cepat atau berguling di tempat tidur, seluruh ruangan mulai berputar selama sekitar setengah menit. Saya merasa sangat mual setiap kali serangan ini terjadi. Keluhan ini mulai tiga hari yang lalu. Lengan dan kaki saya sama sekali tidak terasa lemah, dan cara bicara saya normal.
translator_notes: 'nauseous' = 'mual'; 'the room starts spinning' = 'ruangan mulai berputar' (vertigo; alt. 'pusing berputar-putar'). 'during these episodes' = 'setiap kali serangan ini terjadi' (alt. 'saat episode ini'); 'arms or legs' = 'lengan dan kaki' (alt. 'tangan dan kaki', 'tungkai'); 'weakness' = 'lemah' (alt. 'lemas').

speaker: doctor
english: The chest pain you describe, which spreads to your left arm and comes on when you walk, could be a sign of a heart problem. Your ECG today shows some changes, so I am going to refer you to the emergency department right now. Please do not drive yourself there; we will call an ambulance for you.
translation: Nyeri dada yang Anda ceritakan, yang menjalar ke lengan kiri Anda dan muncul saat Anda berjalan, bisa jadi merupakan tanda masalah jantung. Hasil EKG Anda hari ini menunjukkan beberapa perubahan, jadi saya akan merujuk Anda ke IGD sekarang juga. Tolong jangan menyetir sendiri ke sana; kami akan memanggilkan ambulans untuk Anda.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses patient as 'Anda'. 'ECG' = 'EKG', the standard Indonesian abbreviation (alt. 'rekam jantung', 'ECG'); 'emergency department' = 'IGD' (Instalasi Gawat Darurat; alt. 'UGD', 'unit gawat darurat'). 'Please' = 'Tolong' as in all doctor items (alt. 'Mohon'); 'drive yourself' = 'menyetir sendiri' (alt. 'mengemudi sendiri'); 'spreads' = 'menjalar'.

speaker: doctor
english: Since you are sixty-five years old and have diabetes, I strongly recommend that you get the influenza vaccine every year, as well as the pneumococcal vaccine. These are subsidised for you under the national schedule. You may have a sore arm or a mild fever for a day or two after the injection, which is normal.
translation: Karena Anda berusia enam puluh lima tahun dan menderita diabetes, saya sangat menganjurkan Anda untuk mendapatkan vaksin influenza setiap tahun, dan juga vaksin pneumokokus. Vaksin-vaksin ini disubsidi untuk Anda berdasarkan jadwal imunisasi nasional. Setelah disuntik, lengan Anda mungkin terasa nyeri atau Anda mungkin mengalami demam ringan selama satu atau dua hari, dan itu normal.
translator_notes: 'national schedule' = 'jadwal imunisasi nasional' ('imunisasi' made explicit for natural Indonesian; alt. 'jadwal vaksinasi nasional', 'program nasional'). 'pneumococcal vaccine' = 'vaksin pneumokokus' (alt. 'vaksin pneumonia'); 'diabetes' kept (lay alt. 'kencing manis'); 'sore arm' = 'lengan terasa nyeri' (alt. 'pegal').

speaker: patient
english: I need to top up my medicine for blood pressure and cholesterol, because I only have about one week left. By the way, ever since I started the new tablet last month, I have been having a dry cough that doesn't go away. Could it be caused by the medicine?
translation: Saya perlu mengambil obat lagi untuk tekanan darah dan kolesterol saya, karena obatnya tinggal sekitar satu minggu lagi. Omong-omong, sejak saya mulai minum tablet yang baru bulan lalu, saya mengalami batuk kering yang tidak kunjung hilang. Apakah mungkin itu disebabkan oleh obatnya?
translator_notes: 'top up my medicine' = 'mengambil obat lagi' (alt. 'menambah stok obat', 'minta resep ulang'); 'blood pressure' = 'tekanan darah' (lay alt. 'darah tinggi'). 'By the way' = 'Omong-omong' (alt. 'Oh ya'); 'doesn't go away' = 'tidak kunjung hilang' (alt. 'tidak sembuh-sembuh').

speaker: doctor
english: This antihistamine will help with the itching and sneezing, but it can make you drowsy, so please do not drive or operate machinery after taking it. Take one tablet at night before you sleep. Do you have any drug allergies, or are you taking any other medicines or supplements at the moment?
translation: Antihistamin ini akan membantu mengatasi gatal dan bersin, tetapi obat ini bisa membuat Anda mengantuk, jadi tolong jangan menyetir atau mengoperasikan mesin setelah meminumnya. Minumlah satu tablet pada malam hari sebelum tidur. Apakah Anda memiliki alergi obat, atau apakah Anda sedang mengonsumsi obat atau suplemen lain saat ini?
translator_notes: 'antihistamine' = 'antihistamin' (alt. 'obat antihistamin', 'obat alergi'); 'drowsy' = 'mengantuk'. 'taking other medicines' = 'mengonsumsi obat' (alt. 'minum obat'); 'operate machinery' = 'mengoperasikan mesin' (alt. 'menjalankan mesin'); doctor uses 'Anda' and 'tolong' for 'please' (alt. 'mohon').

speaker: doctor
english: Your antigen rapid test is positive for COVID-19. Your symptoms are mild, so you can recover at home. I will give you medicine for the fever and cough, and a medical certificate for five days. Please wear a mask when you go out, and avoid visiting your elderly relatives until you feel better.
translation: Hasil tes cepat antigen Anda positif COVID-19. Gejala Anda ringan, jadi Anda bisa pulih di rumah. Saya akan memberi Anda obat untuk demam dan batuk, serta surat keterangan sakit untuk lima hari. Tolong pakai masker saat keluar rumah, dan hindari mengunjungi kerabat Anda yang sudah lanjut usia sampai Anda merasa lebih baik.
translator_notes: 'antigen rapid test' = 'tes cepat antigen' (very common alt. 'rapid test antigen', 'swab antigen'); 'medical certificate' = 'surat keterangan sakit' (alt. 'surat sakit', 'MC'), phrased 'untuk lima hari' as in EN-019; 'please' = 'Tolong' (alt. 'Mohon'). 'elderly relatives' = 'kerabat yang sudah lanjut usia' (alt. 'saudara yang lansia'); 'COVID-19' kept as loanword.

speaker: patient
english: Doctor, I've had a runny nose and a blocked nose for about four days now. Since yesterday I've also started sneezing a lot and my throat feels scratchy, especially in the morning. I don't think I have a fever, but I feel very tired and my whole body is aching.
translation: डॉक्टर, लगभग चार दिन से मेरी नाक बह रही है और बंद भी है। कल से मुझे बहुत छींकें भी आने लगी हैं और गले में ख़राश महसूस होती है, ख़ासकर सुबह के समय। मुझे नहीं लगता कि मुझे बुख़ार है, लेकिन मैं बहुत थका हुआ महसूस कर रहा हूँ और मेरे पूरे शरीर में दर्द हो रहा है।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('थका हुआ महसूस कर रहा हूँ'; female 'थकी हुई ... रही हूँ'). 'Scratchy throat' = 'गले में ख़राश', 'aching' = 'शरीर में दर्द' (alt. 'बदन दर्द'), and 'Doctor' may also be 'डॉक्टर साहब'. Nukta spellings used set-wide ('ख़राश', 'ख़ासकर', 'बुख़ार'); non-nukta variants 'खराश', 'खासकर', 'बुखार' are the same words.

speaker: doctor
english: From what I can see, this looks like a viral infection of the upper airway, so antibiotics will not help you. I will give you some medicine for the runny nose and lozenges for your throat. Drink plenty of warm water, rest well, and come back if you are not better in five days.
translation: जो मैं देख पा रहा हूँ, उससे लगता है कि यह साँस की ऊपरी नली का वायरल इन्फ़ेक्शन है, इसलिए एंटीबायोटिक से आपको कोई फ़ायदा नहीं होगा। मैं आपको बहती नाक के लिए कुछ दवा और गले के लिए चूसने वाली गोलियाँ दूँगा। ख़ूब गुनगुना पानी पीजिए, अच्छे से आराम कीजिए, और अगर पाँच दिन में आप ठीक न हों तो दोबारा आइए।
translator_notes: Male doctor default using 'आप' with polite imperatives ('पीजिए', 'आइए'). 'Upper airway' = 'साँस की ऊपरी नली' (formal 'ऊपरी श्वसन मार्ग'); loanwords 'वायरल इन्फ़ेक्शन' (alt. 'संक्रमण') and 'एंटीबायोटिक'; 'lozenges' = 'चूसने वाली गोलियाँ' (alt. 'लॉज़ेंज'). Nukta spellings 'फ़ायदा', 'ख़ूब', 'इन्फ़ेक्शन' used (non-nukta variants 'फायदा', 'खूब', 'इन्फेक्शन').

speaker: patient
english: My temperature has been going up and down for three days. Last night it reached thirty-nine point two degrees. I took two Panadol tablets and it came down a little, but after a few hours the fever came back. I also have chills and I have been sweating a lot at night.
translation: तीन दिन से मेरा टेम्परेचर ऊपर-नीचे हो रहा है। कल रात यह उनतालीस पॉइंट दो डिग्री तक पहुँच गया था। मैंने पैनाडोल की दो गोलियाँ लीं और यह थोड़ा कम हुआ, लेकिन कुछ घंटों बाद बुख़ार फिर से आ गया। मुझे ठंड लगकर कँपकँपी भी हो रही है और रात में बहुत पसीना आ रहा है।
translator_notes: Male patient default (verbs here are gender-neutral). 'Temperature' = 'टेम्परेचर' (alt. 'तापमान'); 'point' = spoken 'पॉइंट', as in EN-015 (formal 'दशमलव'); 'Panadol' = 'पैनाडोल'; 'chills' = 'ठंड लगकर कँपकँपी' (alt. 'ठंड लगना'). Nukta spelling 'बुख़ार' used set-wide (variant 'बुखार').

speaker: doctor
english: Because you have had a high fever for three days with pain behind your eyes and body aches, I am worried this could be dengue. I will send you for a blood test today to check your platelet count. Please avoid ibuprofen and aspirin, and only take paracetamol for the fever.
translation: क्योंकि आपको तीन दिन से तेज़ बुख़ार है, साथ में आँखों के पीछे दर्द और शरीर में दर्द भी है, मुझे चिंता है कि यह डेंगू हो सकता है। मैं आज आपको ब्लड टेस्ट के लिए भेजूँगा ताकि आपके प्लेटलेट काउंट की जाँच हो सके। कृपया आइबुप्रोफ़ेन और एस्पिरिन न लें, और बुख़ार के लिए सिर्फ़ पैरासिटामोल लें।
translator_notes: Male doctor default ('भेजूँगा') using 'आप'. Loanwords 'डेंगू', 'ब्लड टेस्ट' (alt. 'ख़ून की जाँच'), 'प्लेटलेट काउंट'; drugs 'आइबुप्रोफ़ेन' (alt. 'इबुप्रोफ़ेन'), 'एस्पिरिन', 'पैरासिटामोल'. Nukta spellings 'तेज़', 'बुख़ार', 'सिर्फ़', 'आइबुप्रोफ़ेन' used (non-nukta variants are the same words).

speaker: patient
english: My throat has been very painful for two days, and it hurts so much when I swallow that I can barely eat. When I looked in the mirror, I saw some white spots at the back of my throat. My neck also feels a bit swollen and tender on both sides.
translation: दो दिन से मेरे गले में बहुत दर्द है, और निगलते समय इतना दर्द होता है कि मैं मुश्किल से कुछ खा पाता हूँ। जब मैंने शीशे में देखा, तो मुझे गले के पीछे कुछ सफ़ेद धब्बे दिखे। मेरी गर्दन भी दोनों तरफ़ से थोड़ी सूजी हुई लगती है और छूने पर दर्द होता है।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('खा पाता हूँ'; female 'खा पाती हूँ'). 'Tender' = 'छूने पर दर्द होता है' (alt. 'दबाने पर दर्द'); 'mirror' = 'शीशे' (alt. 'आईने'); 'white spots' = 'सफ़ेद धब्बे' (alt. 'सफ़ेद दाने'). Nukta spellings 'सफ़ेद', 'तरफ़' used (variants 'सफेद', 'तरफ').

speaker: doctor
english: Your tonsils are swollen and there is pus on them, which suggests a bacterial infection. I am going to prescribe a course of antibiotics for seven days. Please finish the whole course even if you feel better after two or three days, otherwise the infection may come back.
translation: आपके टॉन्सिल सूजे हुए हैं और उन पर मवाद है, जिससे लगता है कि यह बैक्टीरियल इन्फ़ेक्शन है। मैं आपको सात दिन का एंटीबायोटिक का कोर्स लिख रहा हूँ। अगर दो या तीन दिन बाद आप बेहतर महसूस करें, तब भी कृपया पूरा कोर्स ख़त्म कीजिए, वरना इन्फ़ेक्शन फिर से लौट सकता है।
translator_notes: Male doctor default ('लिख रहा हूँ', alt. 'लिखने जा रहा हूँ') using 'आप'. 'Pus' = 'मवाद' (alt. 'पस'); loanwords 'टॉन्सिल', 'बैक्टीरियल इन्फ़ेक्शन', 'एंटीबायोटिक का कोर्स'. Nukta spellings 'इन्फ़ेक्शन', 'ख़त्म' used (variants 'इन्फेक्शन', 'खत्म').

speaker: patient
english: I have had a cough for almost three weeks now. At the start it was a dry cough, but now I am coughing up yellowish phlegm. The coughing is worse at night and sometimes it keeps me awake. I also feel a bit breathless when I climb the stairs to my flat.
translation: मुझे खाँसी होते हुए अब लगभग तीन हफ़्ते हो गए हैं। शुरू में सूखी खाँसी थी, लेकिन अब खाँसी के साथ पीला-सा बलग़म निकल रहा है। रात में खाँसी ज़्यादा होती है और कभी-कभी इसकी वजह से मैं सो नहीं पाता। अपने फ़्लैट की सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ते समय मेरी साँस भी थोड़ी फूलने लगती है।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('सो नहीं पाता'; female 'सो नहीं पाती'). 'Phlegm' = 'बलग़म', 'breathless' = 'साँस फूलना', 'keeps me awake' = 'सो नहीं पाता' (alt. 'जागता रहता हूँ'), 'flat' = loanword 'फ़्लैट' (alt. 'घर'). Nukta spellings 'हफ़्ते', 'ज़्यादा', 'बलग़म', 'फ़्लैट' used (variants 'हफ्ते', 'ज्यादा', 'बलगम', 'फ्लैट').

speaker: doctor
english: I am going to show you how to use this inhaler properly. First, shake it well, then breathe out fully. Put the mouthpiece in your mouth and press down once while you breathe in slowly and deeply. Then hold your breath for about ten seconds before you breathe out again.
translation: मैं आपको दिखाता हूँ कि इस इनहेलर को सही तरीक़े से कैसे इस्तेमाल करना है। पहले इसे अच्छी तरह हिलाइए, फिर पूरी साँस बाहर छोड़िए। माउथपीस को मुँह में रखिए और धीरे-धीरे गहरी साँस अंदर लेते हुए इसे एक बार दबाइए। फिर लगभग दस सेकंड तक साँस रोककर रखिए, उसके बाद दोबारा साँस बाहर छोड़िए।
translator_notes: Male doctor default ('दिखाता हूँ', alt. 'दिखाने जा रहा हूँ') with polite 'आप' imperatives ('हिलाइए', 'दबाइए'). Loanwords 'इनहेलर', 'माउथपीस' (alt. 'मुँह वाला हिस्सा'), 'सेकंड'. Nukta spelling 'तरीक़े' used (variant 'तरीके').

speaker: patient
english: Since yesterday evening I have had diarrhoea about six or seven times, and I vomited twice this morning. I think it might be from the seafood I ate at a hawker centre. I have some stomach cramps, and I feel weak and dizzy when I stand up too quickly.
translation: कल शाम से मुझे लगभग छह या सात बार दस्त हो चुके हैं, और आज सुबह दो बार उल्टी हुई। मुझे लगता है कि शायद यह हॉकर सेंटर में खाए सीफ़ूड की वजह से है। मेरे पेट में थोड़ी मरोड़ हो रही है, और जब मैं बहुत जल्दी खड़ा होता हूँ तो मुझे कमज़ोरी और चक्कर महसूस होते हैं।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('खड़ा होता हूँ'; female 'खड़ी होती हूँ'). 'Diarrhoea' = 'दस्त' (alt. 'लूज़ मोशन'); 'stomach cramps' = 'पेट में मरोड़' (alt. 'ऐंठन'); 'hawker centre' and 'seafood' kept as loanwords 'हॉकर सेंटर', 'सीफ़ूड' (same spelling as EN-027; alt. 'समुद्री खाना'). Nukta spellings 'सीफ़ूड', 'कमज़ोरी' used (variants 'सीफूड', 'कमजोरी').

speaker: doctor
english: You are a little dehydrated, so the most important thing is to replace the fluids you have lost. Take small sips of this oral rehydration solution frequently throughout the day. Avoid oily and spicy food and milk for now, and come back immediately if you see blood in your stool.
translation: आपके शरीर में थोड़ी पानी की कमी हो गई है, इसलिए सबसे ज़रूरी बात यह है कि जो तरल पदार्थ निकल गया है उसकी भरपाई की जाए। यह ओआरएस का घोल दिन भर थोड़ी-थोड़ी देर में छोटे-छोटे घूँट लेकर पीते रहिए। फ़िलहाल तेल वाला और मसालेदार खाना और दूध लेने से बचिए, और अगर मल में ख़ून दिखे तो तुरंत वापस आइए।
translator_notes: Doctor uses 'आप' imperatives ('पीते रहिए', 'बचिए', 'आइए'); no gendered verbs. 'Dehydrated' = 'शरीर में पानी की कमी' (alt. 'डिहाइड्रेशन'); 'oral rehydration solution' = 'ओआरएस का घोल' (alt. 'नमक-चीनी का घोल'); 'fluids' = 'तरल पदार्थ' as in EN-024; 'stool' = 'मल' (colloquial 'पॉटी'). Nukta spellings 'ज़रूरी', 'फ़िलहाल', 'ख़ून' used (variants 'जरूरी', 'फिलहाल', 'खून').

speaker: patient
english: I often get a burning feeling in my chest and upper stomach, especially after big meals or when I lie down at night. Sometimes a sour liquid comes up into my throat. It has been happening for about two months, and it gets worse whenever I drink coffee.
translation: मुझे अक्सर सीने और पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से में जलन होती है, ख़ासकर ज़्यादा खाना खाने के बाद या रात को लेटने पर। कभी-कभी खट्टा पानी गले तक ऊपर आ जाता है। ऐसा लगभग दो महीने से हो रहा है, और जब भी मैं कॉफ़ी पीता हूँ तो यह और बढ़ जाता है।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('पीता हूँ'; female 'पीती हूँ'). 'Burning feeling' = 'जलन' (alt. 'एसिडिटी'); 'chest' = 'सीना' as in EN-031 (alt. 'छाती'); 'sour liquid' = 'खट्टा पानी'; 'big meals' = 'ज़्यादा खाना' (alt. 'भारी खाना'). Nukta spellings 'ख़ासकर', 'ज़्यादा', 'कॉफ़ी' used (variants 'खासकर', 'ज्यादा', 'कॉफी').

speaker: patient
english: I am here for my blood pressure follow-up. I have been taking my medicine every morning, but sometimes I forget on the weekends. When I checked at home last week, the reading was around one hundred and fifty over ninety-five. I have also been getting headaches at the back of my head.
translation: मैं अपने ब्लड प्रेशर के फ़ॉलो-अप के लिए आया हूँ। मैं हर सुबह अपनी दवा ले रहा हूँ, लेकिन कभी-कभी वीकेंड पर भूल जाता हूँ। पिछले हफ़्ते जब मैंने घर पर चेक किया, तो रीडिंग लगभग एक सौ पचास बटा पंचानवे थी। मुझे सिर के पिछले हिस्से में सिरदर्द भी हो रहा है।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('आया हूँ', 'भूल जाता हूँ'). BP 'over' = 'बटा' (spoken alt. 'बाई'; 'डेढ़ सौ' natural for 150); loanwords 'ब्लड प्रेशर' (alt. 'बीपी'), 'फ़ॉलो-अप', 'रीडिंग', 'वीकेंड' (alt. 'शनिवार-रविवार'). Nukta spellings 'फ़ॉलो-अप', 'हफ़्ते' used (variants 'फॉलो-अप', 'हफ्ते').

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is still higher than we would like it to be. I am going to increase the dose of your medication from five milligrams to ten milligrams once a day. Please also try to cut down on salty food, such as instant noodles, soups and sauces, and exercise regularly.
translation: आज आपका ब्लड प्रेशर अभी भी उससे ज़्यादा है जितना हम चाहते हैं। मैं आपकी दवा की डोज़ पाँच मिलीग्राम से बढ़ाकर दस मिलीग्राम दिन में एक बार करने जा रहा हूँ। कृपया ज़्यादा नमक वाला खाना भी कम करने की कोशिश कीजिए, जैसे इंस्टेंट नूडल्स, सूप और सॉस, और नियमित रूप से एक्सरसाइज़ कीजिए।
translator_notes: Male doctor default ('करने जा रहा हूँ'; female 'रही हूँ') using 'आप'. Loanwords 'ब्लड प्रेशर', 'डोज़', 'एक्सरसाइज़' are what speakers say (formal 'रक्तचाप', 'ख़ुराक', 'व्यायाम'; spoken 'बीपी'); 'ज़्यादा नमक वाला खाना' for 'salty food' avoids 'नमकीन' (savoury snacks). Nukta spellings 'ज़्यादा', 'डोज़', 'एक्सरसाइज़' used (non-nukta variants are the same words).

speaker: patient
english: I have been feeling very thirsty lately, and I need to go to the toilet many times at night to pass urine. I have also lost about four kilograms in the last two months even though I was not trying to diet. My mother has diabetes, so I am a bit worried.
translation: पिछले कुछ समय से मुझे बहुत प्यास लग रही है, और रात में पेशाब करने के लिए मुझे कई बार टॉयलेट जाना पड़ता है। पिछले दो महीनों में मेरा वज़न लगभग चार किलो भी कम हो गया है, जबकि मैं डाइटिंग नहीं कर रहा था। मेरी माँ को डायबिटीज़ है, इसलिए मुझे थोड़ी चिंता हो रही है।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('कर रहा था'; female 'कर रही थी'). 'डायबिटीज़' used set-wide (colloquial 'शुगर (की बीमारी)', formal 'मधुमेह'); 'चार किलो' natural ('चार किलोग्राम' valid); 'lately' = 'पिछले कुछ समय से' as in EN-025 (alt. 'आजकल'); 'बाथरूम' valid for 'टॉयलेट'. Nukta spellings 'वज़न', 'डायबिटीज़' used (variants 'वजन', 'डायबिटीज').

speaker: doctor
english: Your HbA1c result is eight point five percent, which means your blood sugar has been poorly controlled over the past three months. I would like to start you on metformin, one tablet twice a day after meals. You may have some stomach upset at first, but it usually gets better.
translation: आपका HbA1c का रिज़ल्ट आठ पॉइंट पाँच प्रतिशत है, जिसका मतलब है कि पिछले तीन महीनों से आपका ब्लड शुगर ठीक से कंट्रोल में नहीं रहा है। मैं आपको मेटफ़ॉर्मिन देना शुरू करना चाहूँगा, एक गोली दिन में दो बार खाना खाने के बाद। शुरू-शुरू में आपका पेट थोड़ा ख़राब हो सकता है, लेकिन आमतौर पर यह ठीक हो जाता है।
translator_notes: 'HbA1c' kept in Latin letters; 8.5% = 'आठ पॉइंट पाँच प्रतिशत', matching spoken 'पॉइंट' in EN-003 (alts 'आठ दशमलव पाँच प्रतिशत', 'साढ़े आठ परसेंट'). Male doctor default ('चाहूँगा'); 'रिपोर्ट' for 'रिज़ल्ट' and 'नियंत्रण' for 'कंट्रोल' are acceptable. Nukta spellings 'रिज़ल्ट', 'मेटफ़ॉर्मिन', 'ख़राब' used (variants 'रिजल्ट', 'मेटफॉर्मिन', 'खराब').

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood test shows that your bad cholesterol, LDL, is quite high, which increases your risk of heart attack and stroke. I recommend starting a statin, which you take once a day at night. We will repeat the blood test in three months to check your liver and cholesterol levels.
translation: आपके ब्लड टेस्ट से पता चलता है कि आपका ख़राब कोलेस्ट्रॉल, LDL, काफ़ी ज़्यादा है, जिससे आपको हार्ट अटैक और स्ट्रोक का ख़तरा बढ़ जाता है। मैं आपको स्टैटिन शुरू करने की सलाह देता हूँ, जिसे आप दिन में एक बार रात को लेंगे। तीन महीने बाद हम आपके लिवर और कोलेस्ट्रॉल के लेवल चेक करने के लिए ब्लड टेस्ट दोबारा करेंगे।
translator_notes: 'LDL' kept in Latin (Devanagari 'एलडीएल' also seen); 'स्टैटिन', 'हार्ट अटैक', 'स्ट्रोक' are the usual loanwords (formal 'दिल का दौरा', 'लकवा/पक्षाघात'); 'ख़राब कोलेस्ट्रॉल' for 'bad cholesterol' ('बैड कोलेस्ट्रॉल' also common). Male doctor default ('देता हूँ'); 'जाँच', 'स्तर' are formal alternatives to 'चेक', 'लेवल'. Nukta spellings 'ख़राब', 'काफ़ी', 'ज़्यादा', 'ख़तरा' used (non-nukta variants are the same words).

speaker: patient
english: I keep getting very bad headaches on one side of my head, usually two or three times a week. When it happens, I feel like vomiting and I cannot stand bright lights or loud noises. The painkillers I bought from the pharmacy don't help much anymore.
translation: मुझे बार-बार सिर के एक तरफ़ बहुत तेज़ दर्द होता है, आमतौर पर हफ़्ते में दो या तीन बार। जब ऐसा होता है, तो मुझे उल्टी जैसा लगता है और मैं तेज़ रोशनी या तेज़ आवाज़ बर्दाश्त नहीं कर पाता। मैंने फ़ार्मेसी से जो पेनकिलर ख़रीदे थे, वे अब ज़्यादा असर नहीं करते।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('कर पाता'; female 'कर पाती'). 'पेनकिलर' as in EN-019 (alts 'दर्द की दवा/गोलियाँ'), 'फ़ार्मेसी' (alt. 'मेडिकल स्टोर'/'केमिस्ट'), 'उल्टी जैसा लगता है' (alt. 'जी मिचलाता है'); 'दो-तीन बार' is an acceptable variant. Nukta spellings 'तरफ़', 'तेज़', 'हफ़्ते', 'आवाज़', 'ख़रीदे', 'ज़्यादा' used (non-nukta variants are the same words).

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back when I was lifting a heavy box at work on Monday. The pain is very sharp when I bend forward or get up from a chair. Sometimes the pain goes down to the back of my right leg, and my toes feel a bit numb.
translation: सोमवार को काम पर एक भारी डिब्बा उठाते समय मेरी कमर के निचले हिस्से में चोट लग गई। जब मैं आगे की ओर झुकता हूँ या कुर्सी से उठता हूँ, तो बहुत तेज़ दर्द होता है। कभी-कभी दर्द मेरे दाएँ पैर के पिछले हिस्से तक नीचे जाता है, और मेरे पैर की उँगलियाँ थोड़ी सुन्न लगती हैं।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('झुकता हूँ', 'उठता हूँ'; female 'झुकती', 'उठती'). 'Lower back' = 'कमर के निचले हिस्से' as in EN-019 (many say just 'कमर'); 'leg' = 'पैर' (alt. 'टाँग'), 'दाहिने' alt. for 'दाएँ', 'डिब्बा' alt. 'बॉक्स'; 'सुन्न' = numb. Standard chandrabindu 'उँगलियाँ' (variant 'उंगलियाँ') and nukta 'तेज़' (variant 'तेज').

speaker: doctor
english: This looks like a muscle strain in your lower back. I will give you painkillers, a muscle relaxant, and a medical certificate for three days. Try to keep moving gently instead of staying in bed all day. If you have weakness in your legs or problems controlling your bladder, go to the emergency department immediately.
translation: यह आपकी कमर के निचले हिस्से में मांसपेशी का खिंचाव लग रहा है। मैं आपको पेनकिलर, मसल रिलैक्सेंट, और तीन दिन का मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट दूँगा। पूरा दिन बिस्तर पर लेटे रहने के बजाय धीरे-धीरे चलते-फिरते रहने की कोशिश कीजिए। अगर आपके पैरों में कमज़ोरी महसूस हो या पेशाब पर कंट्रोल रखने में परेशानी हो, तो तुरंत इमरजेंसी विभाग में जाइए।
translator_notes: Male doctor default ('दूँगा'), 'आप' forms ('कीजिए', 'जाइए'). 'मांसपेशी का खिंचाव' (alt. 'मसल स्ट्रेन'); 'मसल रिलैक्सेंट' kept as clinician loanword; 'पेशाब पर कंट्रोल' for bladder control (formal 'मूत्राशय पर नियंत्रण'); 'मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट' and 'इमरजेंसी विभाग' used set-wide (alts 'एमसी', 'आपातकालीन विभाग'). Nukta spellings 'सर्टिफ़िकेट', 'कमज़ोरी' used (variants 'सर्टिफिकेट', 'कमजोरी').

speaker: patient
english: It hurts and burns every time I pass urine, and I feel like I need to go to the toilet all the time, but only a little comes out. Since this morning my urine also looks cloudy and has a strong smell. I have a little pain in my lower belly too.
translation: हर बार पेशाब करते समय दर्द और जलन होती है, और मुझे लगता है कि मुझे हर समय टॉयलेट जाना है, लेकिन थोड़ा-सा ही निकलता है। आज सुबह से मेरा पेशाब धुंधला भी दिख रहा है और उसमें से तेज़ बदबू आ रही है। मेरे पेट के निचले हिस्से में भी थोड़ा दर्द है।
translator_notes: No gendered verbs needed in this item. 'पेशाब' is the everyday word (formal 'मूत्र'); 'धुंधला' for cloudy (alts 'मटमैला', 'गंदला'); 'तेज़ बदबू' (alt. 'तेज़ गंध'); 'बार-बार' valid for 'हर समय'; 'पेडू' regional alt. for lower belly. Nukta spelling 'तेज़' used (variant 'तेज').

speaker: patient
english: I have this itchy red rash on the inside of my elbows and behind my knees. It gets worse at night, and I keep scratching until the skin bleeds. I have tried using moisturiser, but it doesn't seem to help. Could it be an allergy to my new soap?
translation: मेरी कोहनियों के अंदर की तरफ़ और घुटनों के पीछे ये खुजली वाले लाल चकत्ते हो गए हैं। रात में ये और बढ़ जाते हैं, और मैं तब तक खुजलाता रहता हूँ जब तक त्वचा से ख़ून न निकल आए। मैंने मॉइस्चराइज़र लगाकर देखा है, लेकिन उससे कोई फ़ायदा नहीं लग रहा। क्या यह मेरे नए साबुन से एलर्जी हो सकती है?
translator_notes: Male patient default ('खुजलाता रहता हूँ'; female 'खुजलाती रहती हूँ'). 'Rash' = 'लाल चकत्ते', used set-wide (alts 'दाने', 'रैश'); 'त्वचा' alt. 'स्किन'/'चमड़ी'; 'एलर्जी', 'मॉइस्चराइज़र' standard loanwords; 'खुजाता' variant of 'खुजलाता'. Nukta spellings 'तरफ़', 'ख़ून', 'फ़ायदा', 'मॉइस्चराइज़र' used (non-nukta variants are the same words).

speaker: doctor
english: This is eczema, which is a common condition where the skin becomes dry and inflamed. I will give you a steroid cream to apply thinly twice a day on the red areas, for one week only. Use a gentle soap-free wash, and apply moisturiser generously several times a day, even after the rash is gone.
translation: यह एक्ज़िमा है, जो एक आम समस्या है जिसमें त्वचा सूखी हो जाती है और उसमें सूजन आ जाती है। मैं आपको एक स्टेरॉयड क्रीम दूँगा, जिसे लाल हिस्सों पर दिन में दो बार पतली परत में लगाना है, सिर्फ़ एक हफ़्ते तक। हल्का, बिना साबुन वाला वॉश इस्तेमाल कीजिए, और दिन में कई बार भरपूर मात्रा में मॉइस्चराइज़र लगाइए, चकत्ते ठीक हो जाने के बाद भी।
translator_notes: Male doctor default ('दूँगा'). 'एक्ज़िमा' (also 'एग्ज़िमा'); 'सूजन' covers 'inflamed'; 'समस्या' alt. 'बीमारी'; 'बिना साबुन वाला वॉश' = soap-free wash; 'rash' = 'चकत्ते' as in EN-021. Nukta spellings 'सिर्फ़', 'हफ़्ते', 'एक्ज़िमा', 'मॉइस्चराइज़र' used (non-nukta variants are the same words).

speaker: patient
english: My son is four years old and he has had a fever since yesterday. Today I noticed small blisters on his palms and the soles of his feet, and he has some ulcers in his mouth. He refuses to eat or drink because it hurts. His preschool said another child had hand, foot and mouth disease.
translation: मेरा बेटा चार साल का है और उसे कल से बुख़ार है। आज मैंने देखा कि उसकी हथेलियों और पैरों के तलवों पर छोटे-छोटे फफोले हैं, और उसके मुँह में कुछ छाले हैं। दर्द होने की वजह से वह खाने-पीने से मना कर रहा है। उसके प्रीस्कूल ने बताया कि एक और बच्चे को हाथ, पैर और मुँह की बीमारी थी।
translator_notes: Parent's gender not marked by the grammar here. Blisters = 'फफोले' and mouth ulcers = 'छाले' kept distinct; HFMD = 'हाथ, पैर और मुँह की बीमारी' (loan 'HFMD' also heard); 'another child' = 'एक और बच्चे' (alt. 'किसी दूसरे बच्चे'); 'प्रीस्कूल' alt. 'प्ले स्कूल'. Nukta spelling 'बुख़ार' used (variant 'बुखार').

speaker: doctor
english: Your son has hand, foot and mouth disease. It is caused by a virus and usually gets better on its own within seven to ten days. He must stay at home and not go to preschool until all the blisters have dried. Make sure he drinks enough fluids, and bring him back if he becomes very drowsy or stops passing urine.
translation: आपके बेटे को हाथ, पैर और मुँह की बीमारी है। यह एक वायरस से होती है और आमतौर पर सात से दस दिनों में अपने आप ठीक हो जाती है। जब तक सारे फफोले सूख न जाएँ, तब तक उसे घर पर ही रहना होगा और प्रीस्कूल नहीं जाना है। ध्यान रखिए कि वह पर्याप्त मात्रा में तरल पदार्थ पिए, और अगर उसे बहुत ज़्यादा नींद आने लगे या वह पेशाब करना बंद कर दे, तो उसे दोबारा यहाँ ले आइए।
translator_notes: Doctor uses 'आप' ('रखिए', 'ले आइए'); no doctor-gendered verbs. 'फफोले' and the HFMD term match EN-023; 'वायरस' standard (formal 'विषाणु'); 'तरल पदार्थ' for fluids as in EN-010; 'drowsy' = 'बहुत ज़्यादा नींद आने लगे' (alt. 'बहुत सुस्त हो जाए'). Nukta spelling 'ज़्यादा' used (variant 'ज्यादा').

speaker: patient
english: Every morning when I wake up, I sneeze non-stop and my nose is very runny and itchy. My eyes also become watery and red. It seems to be worse when I clean my room or when there is haze. This has been going on for years, but lately it is getting worse.
translation: हर सुबह जब मैं उठता हूँ, तो मुझे लगातार छींकें आती हैं और मेरी नाक बहुत बहती है और उसमें खुजली होती है। मेरी आँखों से भी पानी आने लगता है और वे लाल हो जाती हैं। ऐसा लगता है कि जब मैं अपना कमरा साफ़ करता हूँ या जब धुंध होती है, तब यह और ज़्यादा बढ़ जाता है। यह कई सालों से हो रहा है, लेकिन पिछले कुछ समय से यह और बिगड़ता जा रहा है।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('उठता हूँ', 'साफ़ करता हूँ'; female 'उठती', 'करती'). 'Haze' = 'धुंध' (alts 'हेज़', 'स्मॉग'); 'non-stop' = 'लगातार' (alt. 'बार-बार'); 'lately' = 'पिछले कुछ समय से' as in EN-014 (alt. 'आजकल'). Nukta spellings 'साफ़', 'ज़्यादा' used (variants 'साफ', 'ज्यादा').

speaker: patient
english: My left eye became red and swollen yesterday, and this morning when I woke up, my eyelashes were stuck together with yellow discharge. It feels gritty, like there is sand inside. Now my right eye is starting to turn red as well. I wear contact lenses for work.
translation: कल मेरी बाईं आँख लाल हो गई और सूज गई, और आज सुबह जब मैं उठा, तो मेरी पलकें पीले कीचड़ से आपस में चिपकी हुई थीं। आँख में किरकिरी सी महसूस होती है, जैसे अंदर रेत हो। अब मेरी दाईं आँख भी लाल होने लगी है। मैं काम के लिए कॉन्टैक्ट लेंस पहनता हूँ।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('उठा', 'पहनता हूँ'; female 'उठी', 'पहनती हूँ'); left eye = 'बाईं आँख', right eye = 'दाईं आँख'. 'Eyelashes' = 'पलकें' as commonly said (precise 'बरौनियाँ'); 'discharge' = colloquial 'कीचड़' (alts 'पीला पानी', formal 'स्राव'); 'gritty' = 'किरकिरी' (alt. 'चुभन'). 'कॉन्टैक्ट लेंस' is the standard loanword.

speaker: patient
english: Last night I woke up with a terrible pain in my big toe. It is red, hot and so swollen that I cannot even put on my shoe or let the blanket touch it. I had a lot of beer and seafood at a wedding dinner on Saturday. Is this gout?
translation: कल रात पैर के अंगूठे में बहुत तेज़ दर्द की वजह से मेरी नींद खुल गई। वह लाल है, गरम है और इतना सूजा हुआ है कि मैं जूता तक नहीं पहन पा रहा हूँ, न ही उस पर कंबल लगने दे पा रहा हूँ। शनिवार को एक शादी की दावत में मैंने बहुत सारी बीयर पी थी और काफ़ी सीफ़ूड खाया था। क्या यह गाउट है?
translator_notes: Male patient default ('पा रहा हूँ'; female 'पा रही हूँ'). 'Big toe' = 'पैर का अंगूठा'; 'gout' = 'गाउट' (alts 'गठिया', 'यूरिक एसिड'); 'seafood' = 'सीफ़ूड' as in EN-009 (alt. 'समुद्री खाना'); 'wedding dinner' = 'शादी की दावत' (alt. 'शादी का डिनर'). Nukta spellings 'तेज़', 'काफ़ी', 'सीफ़ूड' used (variants 'तेज', 'काफी', 'सीफूड').

speaker: patient
english: My knees have been aching for a few years, but recently the pain is much worse, especially when I go up and down the stairs or stand up after sitting for a long time. Sometimes I hear a cracking sound. In the morning my knees feel stiff for about fifteen minutes.
translation: मेरे घुटनों में कुछ सालों से दर्द रहता है, लेकिन हाल ही में दर्द बहुत बढ़ गया है, ख़ासकर जब मैं सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ता-उतरता हूँ या काफ़ी देर बैठने के बाद खड़ा होता हूँ। कभी-कभी मुझे कट-कट की आवाज़ सुनाई देती है। सुबह के समय लगभग पंद्रह मिनट तक मेरे घुटने अकड़े हुए लगते हैं।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('चढ़ता-उतरता हूँ', 'खड़ा होता हूँ'; female 'चढ़ती-उतरती', 'खड़ी होती'). 'Cracking sound' = 'कट-कट की आवाज़' (alts 'चट-चट', 'चटकने की आवाज़'); 'stiff' = 'अकड़े हुए' (alt. 'जकड़े हुए'); 'aching' = 'दर्द रहता है'. Nukta spellings 'ख़ासकर', 'काफ़ी', 'आवाज़' used (variants 'खासकर', 'काफी', 'आवाज').

speaker: patient
english: For the past two months, I have not been able to sleep well. I lie in bed for hours thinking about work, and I wake up at four in the morning and cannot fall back asleep. I feel tired and irritable all day, and I have lost interest in things I used to enjoy.
translation: पिछले दो महीनों से मैं ठीक से सो नहीं पा रहा हूँ। मैं घंटों बिस्तर पर लेटे-लेटे काम के बारे में सोचता रहता हूँ, और सुबह चार बजे मेरी नींद खुल जाती है और फिर दोबारा नींद नहीं आती। मैं पूरे दिन थका हुआ और चिड़चिड़ा महसूस करता हूँ, और जिन चीज़ों में मुझे पहले मज़ा आता था, उनमें अब मेरी दिलचस्पी ख़त्म हो गई है।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('पा रहा हूँ', 'थका हुआ', 'करता हूँ'; female 'रही', 'थकी हुई', 'करती'). 'Irritable' = 'चिड़चिड़ा'; 'lost interest' = 'दिलचस्पी ख़त्म हो गई' (alt. 'मन नहीं लगता', formal 'रुचि'); 'cannot fall back asleep' = 'दोबारा नींद नहीं आती' (alt. 'फिर से सो नहीं पाता'). Nukta spellings 'चीज़ों', 'मज़ा', 'ख़त्म' used (variants 'चीजों', 'मजा', 'खत्म').

speaker: patient
english: Whenever I turn my head quickly or roll over in bed, the whole room starts spinning for about half a minute. I feel very nauseous during these episodes. It started three days ago. I don't have any weakness in my arms or legs, and my speech is normal.
translation: जब भी मैं अपना सिर जल्दी से घुमाता हूँ या बिस्तर पर करवट लेता हूँ, तो लगभग आधे मिनट तक पूरा कमरा घूमने लगता है। ऐसा होने के दौरान मेरा जी बहुत मिचलाता है। यह तीन दिन पहले शुरू हुआ। मेरे हाथों या पैरों में कोई कमज़ोरी नहीं है, और मेरी बोली भी सामान्य है।
translator_notes: Male patient default ('घुमाता हूँ', 'लेता हूँ'; female 'घुमाती', 'लेती'). 'Nauseous' = 'जी मिचलाना' (alts 'मतली होना', 'उल्टी जैसा लगना'); 'roll over' = 'करवट लेना'; 'arms or legs' = idiomatic 'हाथों या पैरों' (alt. 'बाँहों या टाँगों'); 'speech is normal' = 'बोली सामान्य है'. Nukta spelling 'कमज़ोरी' used (variant 'कमजोरी').

speaker: doctor
english: The chest pain you describe, which spreads to your left arm and comes on when you walk, could be a sign of a heart problem. Your ECG today shows some changes, so I am going to refer you to the emergency department right now. Please do not drive yourself there; we will call an ambulance for you.
translation: आपने सीने के जिस दर्द के बारे में बताया, जो आपकी बाईं बाँह तक फैलता है और चलने पर होता है, वह दिल की किसी समस्या का संकेत हो सकता है। आज आपके ECG में कुछ बदलाव दिख रहे हैं, इसलिए मैं आपको अभी तुरंत इमरजेंसी विभाग में रेफ़र करने जा रहा हूँ। कृपया ख़ुद गाड़ी चलाकर वहाँ मत जाइए; हम आपके लिए एम्बुलेंस बुला देंगे।
translator_notes: Doctor uses 'आप' with male default ('करने जा रहा हूँ'; female 'रही हूँ'). 'ECG' kept in Latin (spoken 'ईसीजी'); 'इमरजेंसी विभाग' (formal 'आपातकालीन विभाग'), 'रेफ़र' (alt. 'भेजना'), 'एम्बुलेंस'; 'left arm' = 'बाईं बाँह' (colloquial alt. 'बाएँ हाथ'); 'heart problem' = 'दिल की समस्या' (formal 'हृदय रोग'). Nukta spellings 'रेफ़र', 'ख़ुद' used (variants 'रेफर', 'खुद').

speaker: doctor
english: Since you are sixty-five years old and have diabetes, I strongly recommend that you get the influenza vaccine every year, as well as the pneumococcal vaccine. These are subsidised for you under the national schedule. You may have a sore arm or a mild fever for a day or two after the injection, which is normal.
translation: क्योंकि आपकी उम्र पैंसठ साल है और आपको डायबिटीज़ है, इसलिए मैं आपको ज़ोर देकर सलाह देता हूँ कि आप हर साल इन्फ़्लुएंज़ा का टीका लगवाएँ, और साथ ही न्यूमोकोकल टीका भी। राष्ट्रीय शेड्यूल के तहत ये टीके आपके लिए सब्सिडी पर उपलब्ध हैं। इंजेक्शन के बाद एक-दो दिन तक आपकी बाँह में दर्द या हल्का बुख़ार हो सकता है, जो सामान्य बात है।
translator_notes: Doctor uses 'आप' with male default ('सलाह देता हूँ'; female 'देती हूँ'). 'Vaccine' = 'टीका' (alt. 'वैक्सीन'); 'influenza' = 'इन्फ़्लुएंज़ा' (alt. 'फ़्लू'); 'national schedule' = 'राष्ट्रीय शेड्यूल' (alt. 'राष्ट्रीय टीकाकरण कार्यक्रम'); 'arm' = 'बाँह' as in EN-031; 'diabetes' = 'डायबिटीज़' (alts 'शुगर', 'मधुमेह'). Nukta spellings 'ज़ोर', 'इन्फ़्लुएंज़ा', 'बुख़ार', 'डायबिटीज़' used (non-nukta variants are the same words).

speaker: patient
english: I need to top up my medicine for blood pressure and cholesterol, because I only have about one week left. By the way, ever since I started the new tablet last month, I have been having a dry cough that doesn't go away. Could it be caused by the medicine?
translation: मुझे अपनी ब्लड प्रेशर और कोलेस्ट्रॉल की दवा फिर से लेनी है, क्योंकि मेरे पास सिर्फ़ लगभग एक हफ़्ते की दवा बची है। और हाँ, पिछले महीने जब से मैंने नई गोली शुरू की है, तब से मुझे सूखी खाँसी हो रही है जो जा ही नहीं रही। क्या यह दवा की वजह से हो सकती है?
translator_notes: Male patient default (verbs here are gender-neutral). 'Top up' = 'फिर से लेनी है' (alts 'दोबारा लिखवानी है', 'रीफ़िल'); loanwords 'ब्लड प्रेशर' (alt. 'बीपी') and 'कोलेस्ट्रॉल'; 'by the way' = 'और हाँ' (alt. 'वैसे'); 'doesn't go away' = 'जा ही नहीं रही' (alt. 'ठीक नहीं हो रही'). Nukta spellings 'सिर्फ़', 'हफ़्ते' used (variants 'सिर्फ', 'हफ्ते').

speaker: doctor
english: This antihistamine will help with the itching and sneezing, but it can make you drowsy, so please do not drive or operate machinery after taking it. Take one tablet at night before you sleep. Do you have any drug allergies, or are you taking any other medicines or supplements at the moment?
translation: यह एंटीहिस्टामिन दवा खुजली और छींकों में मदद करेगी, लेकिन इससे आपको नींद आ सकती है, इसलिए इसे लेने के बाद कृपया गाड़ी या कोई मशीन मत चलाइए। रात को सोने से पहले एक गोली लीजिए। क्या आपको किसी दवा से एलर्जी है, या क्या आप अभी कोई और दवाइयाँ या सप्लीमेंट ले रहे हैं?
translator_notes: Doctor uses 'आप' with polite imperatives ('चलाइए', 'लीजिए') and respectful plural 'ले रहे हैं'. 'एंटीहिस्टामिन दवा' (alt. spelling 'एंटीहिस्टामाइन'; 'दवा' added for natural gender agreement); 'drowsy' = 'नींद आ सकती है' (alt. 'सुस्ती'); 'supplements' = 'सप्लीमेंट' (alt. 'विटामिन'); 'drug allergy' = 'किसी दवा से एलर्जी'. No nukta-variant words in this item.

speaker: doctor
english: Your antigen rapid test is positive for COVID-19. Your symptoms are mild, so you can recover at home. I will give you medicine for the fever and cough, and a medical certificate for five days. Please wear a mask when you go out, and avoid visiting your elderly relatives until you feel better.
translation: आपका एंटीजन रैपिड टेस्ट कोविड-19 के लिए पॉज़िटिव है। आपके लक्षण हल्के हैं, इसलिए आप घर पर ही ठीक हो सकते हैं। मैं आपको बुख़ार और खाँसी के लिए दवा दूँगा, और पाँच दिन का मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट भी। कृपया बाहर जाते समय मास्क पहनिए, और जब तक आप ठीक महसूस न करें, तब तक अपने बुज़ुर्ग रिश्तेदारों से मिलने मत जाइए।
translator_notes: Doctor uses 'आप' with male default ('दूँगा'; female 'दूँगी'). 'COVID-19' = 'कोविड-19' as in Hindi media, digits kept as part of the name (Latin 'COVID-19' / 'कोविड उन्नीस' also valid); loanwords 'एंटीजन रैपिड टेस्ट', 'पॉज़िटिव', 'मेडिकल सर्टिफ़िकेट' (alts 'एमसी', 'चिकित्सा प्रमाणपत्र'), 'मास्क'; 'elderly relatives' = 'बुज़ुर्ग रिश्तेदारों'. Nukta spellings 'बुख़ार', 'पॉज़िटिव', 'सर्टिफ़िकेट', 'बुज़ुर्ग' used (non-nukta variants are the same words).

speaker: patient
english: Doctor, I've had a runny nose and a blocked nose for about four days now. Since yesterday I've also started sneezing a lot and my throat feels scratchy, especially in the morning. I don't think I have a fever, but I feel very tired and my whole body is aching.
translation: Dok, mga apat na araw na po akong may tumutulong sipon at baradong ilong. Mula po kahapon, madalas na rin akong bumabahing at parang makati ang lalamunan ko, lalo na sa umaga. Sa tingin ko po ay wala akong lagnat, pero pagod na pagod po ako at nananakit ang buong katawan ko.
translator_notes: Patient speaks politely with 'po' and addresses the doctor as 'Dok'. 'Runny nose' = 'tumutulong sipon' (alt. 'may sipon', 'tumutulo ang sipon'); 'blocked nose' = 'baradong ilong' (alt. 'barado ang ilong', 'nakabara ang ilong'); 'scratchy throat' = 'makati ang lalamunan' (alt. 'makati/magaspang ang lalamunan'); 'aching' = 'nananakit' (alt. 'masakit ang buong katawan'). 'Pero' is standard spoken; 'ngunit/subalit' are formal variants.

speaker: doctor
english: From what I can see, this looks like a viral infection of the upper airway, so antibiotics will not help you. I will give you some medicine for the runny nose and lozenges for your throat. Drink plenty of warm water, rest well, and come back if you are not better in five days.
translation: Sa nakikita ko, mukhang impeksiyon ito ng virus sa itaas na bahagi ng daanan ng hangin, kaya hindi makakatulong sa inyo ang antibiotic. Bibigyan ko kayo ng gamot para sa sipon at ng lozenges para sa lalamunan ninyo. Uminom kayo ng maraming maligamgam na tubig, magpahinga nang mabuti, at bumalik kayo rito kung hindi pa rin kayo bumubuti sa loob ng limang araw.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo/inyo' (without 'po'). 'Upper airway' = 'itaas na bahagi ng daanan ng hangin' (clinicians often code-switch: 'viral infection sa upper airway/upper respiratory tract'); 'virus', 'antibiotic' (alt. 'antibiyotiko') and 'lozenges' (alt. 'kendi/pastilya para sa lalamunan') kept as loanwords; 'maligamgam' = warm (alt. 'mainit-init'). 'Impeksiyon' follows the KWF spelling used throughout the set (common variant 'impeksyon').

speaker: patient
english: My temperature has been going up and down for three days. Last night it reached thirty-nine point two degrees. I took two Panadol tablets and it came down a little, but after a few hours the fever came back. I also have chills and I have been sweating a lot at night.
translation: Tatlong araw na pong pataas-pababa ang temperatura ko. Kagabi, umabot po ito sa tatlumpu't siyam punto dalawang digri. Uminom po ako ng dalawang tabletang Panadol at bumaba ito nang kaunti, pero pagkalipas ng ilang oras ay bumalik ang lagnat. Giniginaw rin po ako at pinagpapawisan nang husto tuwing gabi.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. Numbers in Tagalog words 'tatlumpu't siyam punto dalawa'; speakers very often say it in English ('thirty-nine point two') or Spanish-derived ('trentay nuwebe punto dos'), and 'digri' may appear as 'degrees'. 'Going up and down' = 'pataas-pababa' (alt. 'taas-baba', 'pabalik-balik', 'pabago-bago'); 'chills' = 'giniginaw' (alt. 'nanginginig sa ginaw', 'nangangaligkig'); 'sweating a lot' = 'pinagpapawisan nang husto' (alt. 'pawis na pawis').

speaker: doctor
english: Because you have had a high fever for three days with pain behind your eyes and body aches, I am worried this could be dengue. I will send you for a blood test today to check your platelet count. Please avoid ibuprofen and aspirin, and only take paracetamol for the fever.
translation: Dahil tatlong araw na kayong may mataas na lagnat, kasama ang pananakit sa likod ng mga mata at pananakit ng katawan, nag-aalala ako na baka dengue ito. Ipapa-blood test ko kayo ngayong araw para malaman ang platelet count ninyo. Pakiiwasan ninyo ang ibuprofen at aspirin, at paracetamol lang ang inumin ninyo para sa lagnat.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo/inyo' (without 'po'). 'Dengue', 'blood test', 'platelet count', 'ibuprofen', 'aspirin', 'paracetamol' kept as English loanwords, as is normal in Philippine clinics (alt. 'pasusuriin ko ang dugo ninyo', 'bilang ng platelet'). 'Please avoid' = 'Pakiiwasan ninyo' (alt. 'Iwasan muna ninyo', 'Huwag kayong uminom ng').

speaker: patient
english: My throat has been very painful for two days, and it hurts so much when I swallow that I can barely eat. When I looked in the mirror, I saw some white spots at the back of my throat. My neck also feels a bit swollen and tender on both sides.
translation: Dalawang araw na pong napakasakit ng lalamunan ko, at sobrang sakit kapag lumulunok ako kaya halos hindi na ako makakain. Nang tumingin po ako sa salamin, may nakita akong mga puting batik sa likod ng lalamunan ko. Medyo namamaga rin po at masakit kapag hinahawakan ang magkabilang gilid ng leeg ko.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'White spots' = 'puting batik' (alt. 'puting tuldok', 'mapuputing parte'); 'tender' rendered as 'masakit kapag hinahawakan' (alt. 'masakit kapag pinipindot/hinihipo'); 'swollen' = 'namamaga'.

speaker: doctor
english: Your tonsils are swollen and there is pus on them, which suggests a bacterial infection. I am going to prescribe a course of antibiotics for seven days. Please finish the whole course even if you feel better after two or three days, otherwise the infection may come back.
translation: Namamaga ang tonsils ninyo at may nana ang mga ito, na nagpapahiwatig ng impeksiyong dulot ng bacteria. Reresetahan ko kayo ng antibiotic na iinumin ninyo nang pitong araw. Pakitapos ninyo ang buong gamutan kahit bumuti na ang pakiramdam ninyo pagkalipas ng dalawa o tatlong araw, dahil kung hindi, baka bumalik ang impeksiyon.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo/inyo' (without 'po'). 'Tonsils', 'bacteria', 'antibiotic' kept as loanwords (alt. 'bakterya', 'antibiyotiko'); 'pus' = 'nana'; 'course' = 'gamutan' (alt. clinicians may say 'ubusin ninyo ang gamot' / 'tapusin ang buong course'); 'suggests' = 'nagpapahiwatig' (alt. 'ibig sabihin ay may'). 'Impeksiyon' in KWF spelling (variant 'impeksyon').

speaker: patient
english: I have had a cough for almost three weeks now. At the start it was a dry cough, but now I am coughing up yellowish phlegm. The coughing is worse at night and sometimes it keeps me awake. I also feel a bit breathless when I climb the stairs to my flat.
translation: Halos tatlong linggo na po akong inuubo. Noong una, tuyong ubo lang, pero ngayon po ay may lumalabas nang madilaw-dilaw na plema kapag umuubo ako. Mas malala po ang ubo ko sa gabi at kung minsan ay hindi ako makatulog dahil dito. Medyo hinihingal din po ako kapag umaakyat ako ng hagdan papunta sa unit ko.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'Phlegm' = 'plema' (alt. 'kalaghala'); 'yellowish' = 'madilaw-dilaw'; 'breathless' = 'hinihingal' (alt. 'kinakapos ng hininga'). 'Flat' rendered as 'unit' (Filipino usage for an apartment); 'flat' or 'bahay' are acceptable alternatives.

speaker: doctor
english: I am going to show you how to use this inhaler properly. First, shake it well, then breathe out fully. Put the mouthpiece in your mouth and press down once while you breathe in slowly and deeply. Then hold your breath for about ten seconds before you breathe out again.
translation: Ituturo ko sa inyo kung paano gamitin nang tama ang inhaler na ito. Una, alugin ninyo ito nang mabuti, at saka ibuga ninyo nang buo ang hangin. Ilagay ninyo ang mouthpiece sa bibig ninyo at pindutin ito nang isang beses habang humihinga kayo papasok nang dahan-dahan at malalim. Pagkatapos, pigilan ninyo ang hininga ninyo nang mga sampung segundo bago kayo huminga ulit palabas.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo/inyo' (without 'po'). 'Inhaler' and 'mouthpiece' kept as English loanwords (no common Tagalog equivalents). 'Breathe out fully' = 'ibuga nang buo ang hangin' (alt. 'huminga palabas hanggang maubos ang hangin'); 'breathe in' = 'humihinga papasok' (alt. 'humihigop ng hangin'); 'hold your breath' = 'pigilan ang hininga'; 'shake' = 'alugin' (alt. 'kalugin').

speaker: patient
english: Since yesterday evening I have had diarrhoea about six or seven times, and I vomited twice this morning. I think it might be from the seafood I ate at a hawker centre. I have some stomach cramps, and I feel weak and dizzy when I stand up too quickly.
translation: Mula pa po kagabi, mga anim o pitong beses na akong nagtatae, at dalawang beses po akong nagsuka kaninang umaga. Sa tingin ko po ay baka dahil ito sa seafood na kinain ko sa hawker centre. Medyo humihilab po ang tiyan ko, at nanghihina at nahihilo ako kapag masyadong mabilis akong tumayo.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'Diarrhoea' = 'nagtatae' (alt. 'nagdudumi nang malabnaw'); 'stomach cramps' = 'humihilab ang tiyan' (alt. 'namimilipit/pumupulikat ang tiyan'); 'seafood' kept as commonly said (alt. 'lamang-dagat'); 'hawker centre' kept as the Singapore proper term. 'Yesterday evening' = 'kagabi' (alt. 'kahapon ng gabi').

speaker: doctor
english: You are a little dehydrated, so the most important thing is to replace the fluids you have lost. Take small sips of this oral rehydration solution frequently throughout the day. Avoid oily and spicy food and milk for now, and come back immediately if you see blood in your stool.
translation: Medyo dehydrated kayo, kaya ang pinakamahalaga ay mapalitan ang mga likidong nawala sa inyo. Inumin ninyo nang pasipsip-sipsip at madalas ang oral rehydration solution na ito sa buong araw. Iwasan muna ninyo ang mamantika at maanghang na pagkain at ang gatas, at bumalik agad kayo kapag may nakita kayong dugo sa dumi ninyo.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo/inyo' (without 'po'). 'Dehydrated' kept as loanword (alt. 'kulang sa tubig ang katawan'); 'oral rehydration solution' kept (alt. 'ORS', brands 'Oresol/Hydrite'); 'small sips' = 'pasipsip-sipsip' (alt. 'pakonti-konti'); 'stool' = 'dumi' (alt. 'tae' is colloquial).

speaker: patient
english: I often get a burning feeling in my chest and upper stomach, especially after big meals or when I lie down at night. Sometimes a sour liquid comes up into my throat. It has been happening for about two months, and it gets worse whenever I drink coffee.
translation: Madalas po akong makaramdam ng parang nasusunog sa dibdib at sikmura ko, lalo na pagkatapos kumain nang marami o kapag humihiga ako sa gabi. Kung minsan po, may maasim na likidong umaakyat sa lalamunan ko. Mga dalawang buwan na po itong nangyayari, at lumalala ito tuwing umiinom ako ng kape.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'Upper stomach' = 'sikmura' (the everyday Tagalog word for the epigastric area; alt. 'itaas na bahagi ng tiyan'); 'burning feeling' = 'parang nasusunog' (alt. 'mahapdi', 'heartburn'); 'big meals' = 'kumain nang marami' (alt. 'kumain nang mabigat/sobra').

speaker: patient
english: I am here for my blood pressure follow-up. I have been taking my medicine every morning, but sometimes I forget on the weekends. When I checked at home last week, the reading was around one hundred and fifty over ninety-five. I have also been getting headaches at the back of my head.
translation: Nandito po ako para sa follow-up ng blood pressure ko. Iniinom ko po ang gamot ko tuwing umaga, pero kung minsan ay nakakalimutan ko kapag Sabado at Linggo. Nang mag-check po ako sa bahay noong isang linggo, mga isandaan at limampu over siyamnapu't lima ang lumabas. Sumasakit din po ang likod ng ulo ko.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'Blood pressure', 'follow-up' and Taglish 'mag-check' kept as commonly said (alt. 'presyon', 'BP', 'magsukat'); 'weekends' = 'Sabado at Linggo' (alt. 'weekend'); 'headaches at the back of my head' = 'sumasakit ang likod ng ulo' (alt. 'masakit ang batok'). The reading uses Tagalog numerals with 'over' ('isandaan at limampu over siyamnapu't lima'; alt. 'isang daan', 'sandaan'), though speakers very often say it in English ('one fifty over ninety-five').

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood pressure today is still higher than we would like it to be. I am going to increase the dose of your medication from five milligrams to ten milligrams once a day. Please also try to cut down on salty food, such as instant noodles, soups and sauces, and exercise regularly.
translation: Mas mataas pa rin ang blood pressure ninyo ngayong araw kaysa sa gusto namin. Ang dosis ng gamot ninyo ay itataas ko mula sa limang milligram at gagawin kong sampung milligram, isang beses sa isang araw. Pakisubukan din ninyong bawasan ang maaalat na pagkain, gaya ng instant noodles, sabaw, at mga sarsa, at mag-ehersisyo kayo nang regular.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo' (no 'po'). 'blood pressure' and 'instant noodles' kept as commonly spoken (alternative 'presyon ng dugo'); 'dosis' may appear as 'dose/dosage', 'milligram' as 'miligramo'. 'sabaw' (soups) may be 'sopas'; 'mag-ehersisyo nang regular' may be 'regular na mag-ehersisyo'.

speaker: patient
english: I have been feeling very thirsty lately, and I need to go to the toilet many times at night to pass urine. I have also lost about four kilograms in the last two months even though I was not trying to diet. My mother has diabetes, so I am a bit worried.
translation: Uhaw na uhaw po ako nitong mga nakaraang araw, at kailangan kong pumunta sa banyo nang maraming beses sa gabi para umihi. Nabawasan din po ako ng mga apat na kilo sa nakalipas na dalawang buwan, kahit hindi naman po ako nagda-diet. May diabetes po ang nanay ko, kaya medyo nag-aalala po ako.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'banyo' for toilet (alternatives 'CR', 'palikuran'); 'kilo' is the spoken form of kilograms ('kilogram' also acceptable). 'diabetes' kept as commonly said (alternatives 'diyabetis', lay 'mataas ang asukal'); 'nitong mga nakaraang araw' may be 'nitong mga nakaraang linggo' or 'lately'; Taglish 'nagda-diet' is the usual spoken form (alt. 'nagpapapayat').

speaker: doctor
english: Your HbA1c result is eight point five percent, which means your blood sugar has been poorly controlled over the past three months. I would like to start you on metformin, one tablet twice a day after meals. You may have some stomach upset at first, but it usually gets better.
translation: Ang resulta ng HbA1c ninyo ay walo punto limang porsiyento, ibig sabihin ay hindi maayos na nakontrol ang blood sugar ninyo sa nakalipas na tatlong buwan. Gusto ko sanang simulan ninyo ang pag-inom ng metformin, isang tableta dalawang beses sa isang araw pagkatapos kumain. Maaaring medyo sumama ang tiyan ninyo sa simula, pero kadalasan ay bumubuti rin ito.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo' (no 'po'). 'HbA1c', 'metformin' and 'blood sugar' kept as spoken (alternative 'asukal sa dugo'); 'tableta' may be 'tablet'. 'Sumama ang tiyan' is the idiom for stomach upset (alternatives 'masira ang tiyan', 'sakit ng tiyan'); number may be rendered 'walong punto limang porsiyento' or 'percent'.

speaker: doctor
english: Your blood test shows that your bad cholesterol, LDL, is quite high, which increases your risk of heart attack and stroke. I recommend starting a statin, which you take once a day at night. We will repeat the blood test in three months to check your liver and cholesterol levels.
translation: Makikita sa blood test ninyo na medyo mataas ang masamang cholesterol ninyo, ang LDL, na nagpapataas ng panganib ninyong magkaroon ng atake sa puso at stroke. Inirerekomenda kong magsimula kayo ng statin, na iniinom isang beses sa isang araw sa gabi. Uulitin natin ang blood test pagkalipas ng tatlong buwan para masuri ang atay ninyo at ang lebel ng cholesterol ninyo.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo' (no 'po'). 'blood test', 'LDL', 'statin', 'stroke' kept as loanwords (alternatives 'pagsusuri ng dugo', 'kolesterol', 'istrok'); 'masamang cholesterol' may appear as English 'bad cholesterol'. 'atake sa puso' for heart attack ('heart attack' also common); 'lebel' may be 'level'.

speaker: patient
english: I keep getting very bad headaches on one side of my head, usually two or three times a week. When it happens, I feel like vomiting and I cannot stand bright lights or loud noises. The painkillers I bought from the pharmacy don't help much anymore.
translation: Paulit-ulit po akong nagkakaroon ng matinding sakit ng ulo sa isang gilid ng ulo ko, kadalasan dalawa o tatlong beses sa isang linggo. Kapag nangyayari ito, parang nasusuka po ako at hindi ko matiis ang maliliwanag na ilaw o malalakas na ingay. Hindi na po masyadong tumatalab ang mga painkiller na binili ko sa botika.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'painkiller' kept as commonly said (alternatives 'pain reliever', 'pampawala ng sakit', 'gamot sa sakit'); 'botika' may be 'parmasya' or 'pharmacy'. 'isang gilid ng ulo' may be 'isang bahagi/banda ng ulo'; 'parang nasusuka' may be 'parang gusto kong sumuka'.

speaker: patient
english: I hurt my lower back when I was lifting a heavy box at work on Monday. The pain is very sharp when I bend forward or get up from a chair. Sometimes the pain goes down to the back of my right leg, and my toes feel a bit numb.
translation: Nasaktan ko po ang ibabang bahagi ng likod ko noong nagbubuhat ako ng mabigat na kahon sa trabaho noong Lunes. Napakatindi po ng kirot kapag yumuyuko ako o tumatayo mula sa upuan. Minsan po, umaabot ang sakit pababa sa likod ng kanang binti ko, at medyo namamanhid ang mga daliri ng paa ko.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'ibabang bahagi ng likod' for lower back (lay alternative 'balakang'); 'kirot' conveys sharp pain (alternatives 'matalim na sakit', 'parang tinutusok'). 'binti' for leg (may be 'hita' if thigh is meant); 'namamanhid' may be 'nangingimay'.

speaker: doctor
english: This looks like a muscle strain in your lower back. I will give you painkillers, a muscle relaxant, and a medical certificate for three days. Try to keep moving gently instead of staying in bed all day. If you have weakness in your legs or problems controlling your bladder, go to the emergency department immediately.
translation: Mukhang muscle strain ito sa ibabang bahagi ng likod ninyo. Bibigyan ko kayo ng mga painkiller, muscle relaxant, at medical certificate para sa tatlong araw. Subukan ninyong patuloy na gumalaw nang dahan-dahan sa halip na nakahiga lang sa kama buong araw. Kung nanghihina ang mga binti ninyo o nahihirapan kayong kontrolin ang pag-ihi ninyo, pumunta agad kayo sa emergency room.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo' (no 'po'). 'muscle strain', 'painkiller', 'muscle relaxant', 'medical certificate' kept as spoken by Filipino clinicians (alternatives 'pilay sa kalamnan', 'pampawala ng sakit', 'pampa-relax ng kalamnan', 'medcert'). 'emergency room' is the usual Philippine term for emergency department and is used for it throughout the set ('ER', 'emergency', 'emergency department' also acceptable).

speaker: patient
english: It hurts and burns every time I pass urine, and I feel like I need to go to the toilet all the time, but only a little comes out. Since this morning my urine also looks cloudy and has a strong smell. I have a little pain in my lower belly too.
translation: Masakit at mahapdi po tuwing umiihi ako, at pakiramdam ko kailangan kong pumunta sa banyo palagi, pero kaunti lang ang lumalabas. Simula po kaninang umaga, mukhang malabo rin ang ihi ko at matapang ang amoy. Medyo masakit din po ang puson ko.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'mahapdi' for burning, 'puson' for lower belly (alternative 'ibabang bahagi ng tiyan'). 'malabo' for cloudy urine (alternative 'maulap'); 'matapang ang amoy' may be 'masangsang/mapanghi ang amoy'; 'banyo' may be 'CR'.

speaker: patient
english: I have this itchy red rash on the inside of my elbows and behind my knees. It gets worse at night, and I keep scratching until the skin bleeds. I have tried using moisturiser, but it doesn't seem to help. Could it be an allergy to my new soap?
translation: May makati at mapulang pantal po ako sa loob na bahagi ng mga siko ko at sa likod ng mga tuhod ko. Lumalala po ito sa gabi, at kinakamot ko nang kinakamot hanggang sa dumugo ang balat. Sinubukan ko na pong gumamit ng moisturizer, pero parang hindi naman po tumatalab. Posible po kayang allergy ito sa bago kong sabon?
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'pantal' for rash, 'moisturizer' and 'allergy' kept as commonly said (alternatives 'lotion/pampahid', 'alerhiya'). 'loob na bahagi ng siko' may be 'tupi/singit ng siko'; 'hindi tumatalab' may be 'hindi nakakatulong'.

speaker: doctor
english: This is eczema, which is a common condition where the skin becomes dry and inflamed. I will give you a steroid cream to apply thinly twice a day on the red areas, for one week only. Use a gentle soap-free wash, and apply moisturiser generously several times a day, even after the rash is gone.
translation: Eczema ito, isang karaniwang kondisyon kung saan nagiging tuyo at namamaga ang balat. Bibigyan ko kayo ng steroid cream na ipapahid nang manipis dalawang beses sa isang araw sa mga mapulang bahagi, sa loob lang ng isang linggo. Gumamit kayo ng banayad na panghugas na walang sabon, at magpahid kayo ng maraming moisturizer nang ilang beses sa isang araw, kahit wala na ang pantal.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo' (no 'po'). 'eczema', 'steroid cream', 'moisturizer' kept as loanwords (alternative 'eksema'); 'namamaga' for inflamed (alternatives 'iritado', 'inflamed'). 'banayad na panghugas na walang sabon' may appear as 'mild na soap-free wash'; 'magpahid ng maraming' may be 'maglagay nang sagana'.

speaker: patient
english: My son is four years old and he has had a fever since yesterday. Today I noticed small blisters on his palms and the soles of his feet, and he has some ulcers in his mouth. He refuses to eat or drink because it hurts. His preschool said another child had hand, foot and mouth disease.
translation: Apat na taong gulang po ang anak kong lalaki at may lagnat na po siya mula pa kahapon. Ngayong araw, napansin ko po ang maliliit na paltos sa mga palad at talampakan niya, at may ilang singaw siya sa bibig. Ayaw po niyang kumain o uminom kasi masakit. Sabi po ng preschool niya, may isa pang bata na nagkaroon ng hand, foot and mouth disease.
translator_notes: Patient uses 'po' as the polite default toward the doctor. 'paltos' for blisters (alternative 'maliliit na tubig-tubig'), 'singaw' for mouth ulcers (alternative 'sugat sa bibig'), 'talampakan' for soles. 'hand, foot and mouth disease' and 'preschool' kept in English as commonly said (alternatives 'HFMD', 'nursery/paaralan'); 'kasi' may be 'dahil'.

speaker: doctor
english: Your son has hand, foot and mouth disease. It is caused by a virus and usually gets better on its own within seven to ten days. He must stay at home and not go to preschool until all the blisters have dried. Make sure he drinks enough fluids, and bring him back if he becomes very drowsy or stops passing urine.
translation: May hand, foot and mouth disease ang anak ninyo. Sanhi ito ng virus at kadalasang gumagaling nang kusa sa loob ng pito hanggang sampung araw. Kailangan niyang manatili sa bahay at huwag munang pumasok sa preschool hanggang matuyo ang lahat ng paltos. Siguraduhin ninyong nakakainom siya ng sapat na likido, at dalhin ninyo siya ulit dito kung sobra siyang inaantok o kung hindi na siya umiihi.
translator_notes: Doctor addresses the patient with polite plural 'kayo/ninyo' (no 'po'). 'hand, foot and mouth disease', 'virus', 'preschool' kept in English; 'paltos' for blisters.
